author: builder
note: Tuning cases were used to set the routing policy; held-out cases were written first and not inspected during tuning. Expected ids are the builder's reading of the catalogue text and need expert review.

cases.text: Our company faces strong competition from rival firms. Analyze the competitive forces in our industry, including buyer and supplier power.
Assess the political, economic, social, technological, environmental and legal factors affecting our expansion into a new country.
We are a startup and need to describe our business model: customers, value proposition, revenue streams and costs.
Employees resist the new system, so we need a plan for organizational change and to manage the transition.
Identify the failure modes in our production line and prioritize the risks.
The order fulfilment process has too many delays and defects; map the process and find the root causes.
Which customer segments should we target and how should we position the product?
Compare three strategic options against criteria and weights to decide which to pursue.
Calculate the net present value and break-even point for this investment.
Compare exam scores between two groups using a t-test and look at the correlation with study time.
Please use SWOT and the Business Model Canvas for this case.
Explain how Maslow and Herzberg motivation theories relate to employee turnover.
Write a poem about the sea.
What is the capital of France?
We want to enter new markets; evaluate growth options such as market penetration, new products and diversification.
Our suppliers are concentrated in one region; how should we classify our purchases and manage supplier relationships?
How satisfied are customers with our service quality, and what do they expect from the service?
Which stakeholders have the most power and interest in this project?
Evaluate whether the training program improved employee skills and behavior.
Design a theory of change and logic model for our community nutrition program.
Translate this sentence into French.
